description: The oyzu preset: Renovate's recommended defaults, plus Oyzu-owned locks regenerated by oyzu lock in the same commit as any update.
Interim until an upstream oyzu manager exists: annotated pins in Oyzu inputs are found with a regex custom manager.

customManagers.description: A pin in an Oyzu input file, annotated on the line above with # renovate: datasource=... depName=... and optionally packageName, registryUrl and versioning.

packageRules.description: Base image digests and Oyzu inputs move together, once a week, in one pull request per repository.
packageRules.groupName: oyzu base images and OS packages
